performance_case.causal_mechanism: A deterministic causal-fingerprint and closure matrix can prevent the autonomous research system from treating accounting parity, terminal inventory cleanup, isolated annual gains, or already failed mechanisms as fresh alpha and rerunning them.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may classify only the listed sealed historical branches, proof boundaries, failure shapes and duplicate guards. It cannot recompute performance, compare incompatible absolute PnL, access OOS, formulate a new strategy, create a candidate, implement Java Phase C, or change any server or research state.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The audit itself cannot improve drawdown. Its only possible future benefit is avoiding branches whose sealed evidence already shows worse path risk, insufficient breadth, unchanged holding distributions, or no economic claim; immediate drawdown effect is zero.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Without an accepted machine-readable closure matrix, later AI sessions can spend scarce local research capacity restating or tuning closed branches. The bounded audit uses idle local capacity while R1 and R2 wait for prospective evidence and must stop without implementation.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The matrix has zero immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect, but may improve research throughput by rejecting duplicate mechanisms before compute or forward evidence is allocated, preserving capacity for genuinely evidence-ready questions.
